attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ce.callee_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.call_edges AS ce INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile AS sp ON ce.caller_symbol_id = sp.symbol_id WHERE ce.passes_as_callback = TRUE AND ce.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL AND sp.name = 'create_graph' AND (sp.file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py' OR sp.module = 'auto_ontology.retrieval.text_to_sql.text_to_sql_graph') ORDER BY symbol_id

request:
When the text-to-SQL LangGraph is assembled by create_graph in auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py, which functions or methods of this repository does create_graph hand over by reference, i.e. pass the function object itself as an argument to another call (as with graph.add_conditional_edges(node, router_fn, ...)) rather than calling it? Count only plain names passed directly as call arguments; functions that create_graph calls itself, values that are the result of a call (such as _make_soft_check_router(...)), lambdas, and local variables holding nodes do not count. Functions passed only inside an if/else branch of create_graph count. Return each distinct function's symbol ID.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This returns the distinct symbol identifiers of the repository functions and methods that the create_graph function in the text-to-SQL graph module passes as callbacks rather than calling itself. It uses the call edge records to keep only callback-style hand-offs, resolving the caller through the symbol profile so the lookup is limited to create_graph in that specific module file. Each matching function is listed once, ordered by its symbol identifier.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT ce.callee_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.call_edges AS ce INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile AS sp ON ce.caller_symbol_id = sp.symbol_id WHERE ce.passes_as_callback = TRUE AND ce.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL AND sp.name = 'create_graph' AND (sp.file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py' OR sp.module = 'auto_ontology.retrieval.text_to_sql.text_to_sql_graph') ORDER BY symbol_id
